blurb: Golf Club of Estrella is a desert golf course with 18 holes featuring varied pars and strategic layouts. Guests can book tee times up to 60 days in advance and enjoy practice facilities including a two-tiered driving range and putting greens. The club also hosts group golf events and tournaments with customizable food and beverage options.
extraNote: All reservations must be guaranteed with Visa, Discover, MasterCard or American Express · Cancellations must be made 24 hours prior to play
